description: This file defines a PHP class 'TemplateImage' which extends 'TemplateText' to handle image-specific field definitions in SuiteCRM. It manages properties like border, width, and height, and provides methods to retrieve and set field definitions accordingly.

classes.name: TemplateImage
classes.description: A class extending 'TemplateText' to support image-specific field properties such as border, width, and height within SuiteCRM's dynamic fields framework.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Constructs and returns an array defining the field metadata, including specifics for image display such as border, width, and height, incorporating values from the object properties and parent class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the mapping of class properties to generic variable definitions ('vardef_map') for dynamic field handling.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the object's properties based on provided values and any existing extended properties (ext1, ext2, ext3) related to border, width, and height.
